title: HTTP, Browser Boundaries, and Transport Security
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by HTTP, Browser Boundaries, and Transport Security.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the HTTP, Browser Boundaries, and Transport Security topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.
